resolution.note: quoted spans and heredoc bodies ignored by kill refusal; substitution still refused; dispatch.test.ts proof

title: Hook full-match kill refusal fires on quoted text and heredoc data
body:
#1318 (t-gapyf24) refuses any Bash command whose text matches the full-match kill pattern (pkill with -f, or kill fed by pgrep with -f), including quoted data: on 2026-11-17 the lead's `echo '... pkill -f ...' >> status.md` and a `printf` task body quoting the pattern were refused, so nothing ran.
Outcome: the refusal tests only executable text: single-quoted spans, double-quoted spans without a command substitution, and heredoc bodies are ignored; a kill fed by a pgrep -f command substitution inside double quotes is still refused.
Proof: cases in test/hook/dispatch.test.ts through src/dispatch/main.ts pre-tool.
